purpose: Teach: うんちく/コトバ/一安心/すませ/まちがい/つづい/マイペース/大雑把

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: ばあさん、若い頃、お父さんが歴史のうんちくを語られたぞ
lines.en: You know, Gran — when your father was younger, he used to go on these long historical tangents.
lines.style: Soft, nostalgic voice. The opening settles into memory — not rushing. Patient, as if watching the past from a distance. Gentle exhale between thoughts.

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.jp: うん、お祖父ちゃん、孫に新しいコトバを教えてらしたわよね、あなた?
lines.en: Oh yes — your grandfather used to teach the grandchildren new words, didn't he, dear?
lines.style: Warm affection threading through the words. Light, conversational rhythm. A knowing glance — she's meeting him in the memory. The 'dear' lands tenderly.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: ばあさん、若い頃、お父さんが結婚されて、一安心したぞ
lines.en: Gran — when your father was younger, he got married and I felt such relief.
lines.style: Slower, more weighted. The relief in the words is genuine and understated. A long pause before 'relief' — letting the emotion land without performance.

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.jp: お祖父ちゃん、ご法事をすませてからお酒を召し上がったわよね、あなた?
lines.en: Your grandfather would finish the memorial service and then have a drink, wouldn't he, dear?
lines.style: Observant, gentle amusement in her voice. Not teasing — noticing something tender about him. The 'dear' is intimate, like they've had this conversation many times before.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: ばあさん、若い頃、お父さんが書類のまちがいを正されたぞ
lines.en: Gran — when your father was younger, he corrected a mistake in some important documents.
lines.style: The words come quietly, with a kind of pride underneath. Small smile in the voice. He's not bragging — he's remembering something he valued about his son.

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.jp: お祖父ちゃん、長年つづいた習慣を大事にされたわよね、あなた?
lines.en: Your grandfather cherished his long-standing habits, didn't he, dear?
lines.style: Soft recognition in her tone. There's a thread of acceptance — maybe understanding something about him she didn't have words for before. Tender, with a hint of knowing sadness.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: ばあさん、お父さんはマイペースで好きなお仕事をされたぞ
lines.en: Gran — your father always worked at his own pace, on things he loved.
lines.style: Quieter, almost wondering at this truth. No judgment — just stating it as something he observed and admired. A breath of acceptance at the end.

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.jp: お祖父ちゃん、お庭のお手入れは大雑把になさってたわよね、あなた?
lines.en: Your grandfather was rather rough with the garden, wasn't he, dear?
lines.style: Gentle laugh underneath the words — not mocking, but warm affection for his imperfection. Intimate, close, like she's sharing a private joke with him. Voice settles near.
